items.title: tianlinxu312/Everything-about-LLMs
items.description: A work in progress.  Trying to write about all interesting or necessary pieces in the current development of LLMs and generative AI.  Gradually adding more topics.
items.author: tianlinxu312

items.title: shibing624/ai-paper-analysis
items.description: Daily in-depth Chinese analyses of frontier AI research papers, including topics such as LLMs, agents, RAG, and RL. AI 前沿论文中文深度解读
items.author: shibing624

items.title: nitefood/ai-bash
items.description: AI - a simple commandline local/remote LLM chat client. Supports any local or remote OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (GPT4o, Gemini, Grok, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio and more), model and system prompt management, multiple conversations support, automatic topic identification and stdin piping (sending files to LLM for inspection)
items.author: nitefood

items.title: ruankie/ecrivai
items.description: Fully automated AI blog writer that uses LangChain and GPT type LLMs for topic selection and content generation
items.author: ruankie

items.title: sinanuozdemir/oreilly-llm-rl-alignment
items.description: This training offers an intensive exploration into the frontier of reinforcement learning techniques with large language models (LLMs). We will explore advanced topics such as Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF), Reasoning LLMs, and demonstrate practical applications such as fine-tuning
items.author: sinanuozdemir

items.title: MADEVAL/AngleCraft
items.description: Turn dry expert topics into high-engagement content with 7 core angles + 3 foundational lenses. An AI skill for any LLM, any niche, any language.
items.author: MADEVAL

items.title: Md-Emon-Hasan/MediGenius
items.description: AI-powered multi-agent medical assistant with a deterministic safety layer — crisis detection, refused-topic hard-stops, dosage grounding, and post-generation diagnosis verification running before and after every LLM call, backed by parallel RAG, Wikipedia, and Tavily retrieval with symptom and drug-question routing.
items.author: Md-Emon-Hasan

items.title: SpreadSheets600/TidyTabs
items.description: AI powered browser tab organization by topic, domain, and context using OpenRouter LLMS
items.author: SpreadSheets600

items.title: ythx-101/x-profile-analyzer
items.description: 🦞 AI X/Twitter user profile analyzer — no X API key, no login. Fetches up to ~300 public tweets via Nitter + Camofox and generates a 10-dimension persona report (topics, style, motivation, activity heatmap) with MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible LLM. X/推特用户画像分析
items.author: ythx-101

items.title: mchittineni/ultimate-ai-engineering-guide
items.description: 200+ AI, Gen AI, LLM, agentic AI, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), AI systems architect, applied AI, LLMOps and AI platform engineering interview questions across 10 topics. Each has a short answer, in-depth detail, a worked example and interview tips.
items.author: mchittineni

items.title: kael-bit/engram-rs
items.description: Memory engine for AI agents — time axis (3-layer decay/promotion) + space axis (self-organizing topic tree). Hybrid search, LLM consolidation. Single Rust binary.
items.author: kael-bit

items.title: akshaymittal143/CloudyBot-DevOps-AI
items.description: Provide a conversational assistant that can answer DevOps-related questions. This helps demonstrate how large language models (LLMs) can be applied to real-world knowledge domains (in this case, cloud and DevOps topics). For students, it’s a fun, interactive example of AI services.
items.author: akshaymittal143

items.title: ankitsharma-tech/Polyagent-Research-Intelligence
items.description: A modular, multi-agent AI research and report generation platform. Enter any topic, and PolyAgent Research Intelligence orchestrates multiple AI agents to retrieve literature, analyze data, and generate a polished report. Built for researchers and AI/ML engineers, leveraging LangChain, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, advanced LLMs, and a Next.js front-end.
items.author: ankitsharma-tech

items.title: BjornMelin/polyagent-research-intelligence
items.description: A modular, multi-agent AI research and report generation platform. Enter any topic, and PolyAgent Research Intelligence orchestrates multiple AI agents to retrieve literature, analyze data, and generate a polished report. Built for researchers and AI/ML engineers, leveraging LangChain, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, advanced LLMs, and a Next.js front-end.
items.author: BjornMelin

items.title: richer-richard/socratic-council
items.description: Local-first desktop app: 16 AI agents from 8 LLM providers debate any topic — with live argument mapping, fact-check badges, and conflict detection.
items.author: richer-richard

items.title: rasmurtech/DeepSeekDeepResearch
items.description: DeepSeekDeepResearch is a Python-based AI assistant that leverages a local LLM (DeepSeek-R1:7b via Ollama), the Google Custom Search API, and asynchronous web scraping to automatically gather and refine information on any research topic.
items.author: rasmurtech

items.title: JacKaL37/TheHardProblem
items.description: Materials and notes for reading groups, discussions, and maybe a podcast on the topic of defining the edges of what it takes to be considered Conscious. The topic is going to get increasingly fraught as LLMs, other AI models, and agentic systems begin to adapt more and more of our cognitive capacities. We're just trying to do the research here.
items.author: JacKaL37

items.title: billy-enrizky/crewai-research-assistant
items.description: The CrewAI Research Assistant is a powerful tool designed to help users explore any topic using AI Agents. Built with CrewAI, Exa, and Streamlit, this assistant supports multiple large language models (LLMs) and offers advanced answering capabilities through Exa. It visualizes the research process in real-time, generates structured research reports
items.author: billy-enrizky

items.title: c1t1zen1/markgitup-research-desk
items.description: Autonomous hourly research desk: a local LLM picks a fresh angle from 24 standing AI/policy/markets topic families, SearXNG gathers the evidence, and nothing publishes without 2+ independent sources. Static site, zero dependencies, built with Hermes Agent.
items.author: c1t1zen1

items.title: Ak-cybe/web-llm-attacks
items.description: Comprehensive red team methodology for Web LLM attacks,  topics: llm-security, prompt-injection, web-security, red-teaming, owasp, agentic-ai
items.author: Ak-cybe
